prompt:
For the line — Three ladies from church already ordered one —: Keep this photo exactly as it is, a tall 9:16 crop at the foot of the steps; add three women. Image 1 is the church. Image 2 is the style — its runner's render and proportions.
Medium close-up at eye level, sharp on them: three different Black church ladies of seventy, about 5.5 heads tall, big round heads, side by side at the foot of the steps facing the lens — on the left a short, plump lady with deep brown skin, round glasses and short white curls, in lilac; in the middle a tall, slim lady with light brown skin, high cheekbones, freckles and a grey bun, in coral, nudging the left one and nodding up the steps; on the right a broad lady with very dark skin, full cheeks and silver braids, in cream — matching wide hats, knowing closed-mouth smiles, eyes up the steps, a handbag in each near hand, four chunky fingers and a thumb on each. Scale true to the set: the bottom step at their ankles.
In frame: three women, the steps, the hedges; nobody else.
A final frame from a 3D animated feature film, stylized storybook render, warm afternoon sun. No lettering, logos or labels but its wordmark.
